ana: Heads-up: found a token delta affecting multiple invoices for Apr 7 morning window. Sharing immediate action list.
tom: Can you post sample customer IDs? I'll start a scoped ledger diff.
ana: Sample query returned top-20 affected accounts — will share CSV to drive. Suspect ingestion backlog + dedupe tombstone race.
li: I'll take ownership of the customer comms + credit memo template. ETA tomorrow 09:00 PT.
refund-bot: Alert: Possible undercount detected (metric: ledger.raw_vs_applied_ratio < 0.99).
ana: Root cause hypothesis: nightly chunk consumer restarted, rewrite of intermediate keys caused tombstones; late batches collided with dedupe window.
tom: Plan for remediation: 1) run a controlled reprocess dry-run; 2) generate per-customer delta; 3) apply backfill for verified deltas; 4) prepare invoice corrections for any residuals. I'll own 1-3.
li: Owned for customer-facing. Will draft a comms triage doc with tiers (auto-credit, manual review, escalation).
infra-bot: Noted: recent node pool autoscaler incident at 02:12 correlates with restart spike.
tom: Small SQL to detect missing tokens (adjust window):
```
SELECT c.customer_id, SUM(raw_tokens) - SUM(ledger_tokens) AS deficit
FROM raw_events r
LEFT JOIN ledger_events l ON r.event_id = l.event_id
JOIN customers c ON r.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE r.event_ts >= '2026-04-07T01:30:00Z' AND r.event_ts < '2026-04-07T04:30:00Z'
GROUP BY c.customer_id
HAVING deficit > 0
ORDER BY deficit DESC
LIMIT 100;
```
ana: For reprocess: use --idempotency-key=pm-2200001111 and dry-run flag first. We'll validate no dupes by comparing event_ids.
li: For comms tiers: Tier A (> $10k impact) -> SLA phone + manual credit memo. Tier B ($1k-$10k) -> automated credit pending review. Tier C (<$1k) -> auto-credit with notification.
tom: ETA: dry-run report today 18:00 PT; apply run tomorrow 02:00 PT if dry-run clean.
li: I'll prepare draft messages and a FAQ. Please add me to the CSV share.
ana: Telemetry actions: add 'reconcile.missing_tokens' gauge and alert if >1000 tokens for 10m. Also track 'replay.duplicate_rate'.
